text: L3_01_01_01 Create Feature Class Creates a new vector feature class with a specified geometry type, properties, and schema.
L3_01_01_03 Create Raster Dataset Creates a new empty raster dataset with specified properties.
L3_01_01_04 XY Table to Point Creates point features from X and Y coordinate fields in a table using a specified coordinate reference system.
L3_01_01_05 Create Point Features from Coordinates Constructs point feature geometry from a coordinate pair and writes the same feature to a target layer or sink.
L3_01_01_06 Create Polyline Features from Vertices Constructs polyline feature geometry from two or more explicit vertices and writes the same feature to a target layer or sink.
L3_01_01_07 Create Features from WKT Geometry
L3_01_01_08 Create Polygon Features from Vertices Constructs polygon feature geometry from explicit ring/vertex sequences and writes the same feature to a sink.
L3_01_01_09 Create Rectangle Features from Extent Constructs rectangle feature geometry from an explicit extent and writes the same feature to a sink.
L3_01_02_01 Add Field Adds a new field (column) to a table or feature class with specified data type and properties.
L3_01_02_02 Delete Field Deletes one or more fields from a table or feature class.
L3_01_02_03 Alter Field Modifies field properties such as name alias or data type.
L3_01_02_06 Calculate Field Calculates field values using an expression or formula.
L3_01_03_04 Merge Merges multiple datasets into a new single dataset.
L3_01_03_05 Attribute Table Join Joins fields from a non-spatial or spatial table to features using a shared key without applying a spatial predicate.
L3_01_05_01 Check Geometry Checks feature geometry for validity and identifies errors.
L3_01_05_02 Repair Geometry Repairs invalid feature geometries automatically.
L3_01_05_04 Delete Identical Deletes duplicate feature records based on geometry and/or attributes.
L3_01_07_01 Add Spatial Index Adds a spatial index to a feature class to improve spatial query performance.
L3_01_08_03 Get Count Returns the number of features or records in a dataset.
L3_01_08_04 Basic Field Statistics Calculates basic summary statistics for values in a selected attribute field.
L3_01_09_01 Vector Format Conversion Converts vector data between different GIS vector formats (Shapefile to GeoJSON to Geodatabase to GeoPackage etc.).
L3_01_09_03 Raster-Vector Conversion Converts between raster and vector formats: raster to polygon/point/line or vector to raster.
L3_01_10_01 Project/Reproject Transforms spatial data from one coordinate reference system (CRS) to another including projection and datum transformation.
L3_01_10_02 Define Projection Defines or updates the coordinate system metadata for a dataset without transforming coordinate values.
L3_01_13_01 Change Pixel Data Type Converts the data type of raster pixels (e.g., from float to integer, or 32-bit to 8-bit). This is also known as casting.
L3_02_01_01 Buffer Creates buffer polygons around input features at a specified distance.
L3_02_02_01 Intersect Computes geometric intersection of input features retaining only overlapping areas with attributes from all inputs.
L3_02_02_02 Union Combines all features from multiple input layers preserving all geometries and attributes.
L3_02_02_04 Erase Removes portions of input features that overlap with erase features.
L3_02_02_05 Symmetrical Difference Extracts features that do not overlap between two input layers (inverse of Intersect).
L3_02_02_06 Clip Extracts input features that fall within the clip features extent like a cookie cutter.
L3_02_02_07 Update Updates input features by replacing overlapping areas with update features; non-overlapping input areas preserved.
L3_02_03_05 Collect Features Aggregates geometries into multi-geometry features (MultiPoint/MultiLineString/MultiPolygon) based on attribute.
L3_02_03_06 Vector Grid Generation Creates a vector fishnet, rectangular, diamond, hexagonal, or regular-point grid over an extent.
L3_02_04_01 Spatial Join Joins attributes from one feature layer to another based on spatial relationship (intersects/contains/within/touches/etc.) without modifying geometry.
L3_02_04_04 Vector Overlap Statistics Adds overlap area and percentage measurements from one or more polygon overlay layers to input features.
L3_02_05_01 Simplify Reduces the complexity of feature geometries by removing vertices while preserving essential shape using tolerance.
L3_02_05_02 Smooth Smooths sharp angles in feature geometries by fitting curves or adding vertices.
L3_02_05_06 Split Line at Point Splits line features at locations where they intersect point features.
L3_02_05_07 Extend Line Extends line features to a specified distance or to intersect other features.
L3_02_05_09 Flip Line Reverses the direction of line features.
L3_02_05_11 Feature to Point Converts features to point features at specified locations (centroid/inside/start/end/mid/vertices).
L3_02_05_12 Minimum Bounding Geometry Creates minimum enclosing geometry (rectangle/circle/convex hull/envelope) for features.
L3_02_05_16 Explode Lines Splits line features into individual two-vertex line segments at every intermediate vertex.
L3_02_05_17 Split Features with Lines Splits line or polygon features where they intersect line features or polygon boundaries from another layer.
L3_02_05_18 Set Z from Raster Sets feature geometry Z values by sampling a raster surface, with optional scaling and offset.
L3_02_05_19 Split Lines by Length Splits line features into consecutive parts no longer than a specified maximum length.
L3_02_06_01 Select by Attribute Selects features or table records based on attribute query (SQL expression).
L3_02_06_02 Extract by Attribute Extracts features to new dataset based on attribute query.
L3_02_06_03 Extract by Location Extracts features to new dataset based on spatial relationship with other features.
L3_02_06_04 Split by Attribute Splits input features into multiple output datasets based on unique attribute values.
L3_02_06_05 Filter by Geometry Filters features based on geometry properties (area/length/vertex count/perimeter).
L3_02_06_06 Sample Points Extracts or generates point samples from input features at specified locations or random/regular distribution.
L3_02_07_01 Multipart to Singlepart Separates multipart features into individual singlepart features or component geometries.
L3_02_07_03 Polygon to Line Converts polygon boundaries to line features.
L3_02_07_04 Points to Line Connects point features into ordered line paths using optional grouping and ordering fields.
L3_02_07_07 Create Thiessen Polygons Creates Thiessen (Voronoi) polygons around point features dividing space based on proximity.
L3_02_07_09 Snap Moves vertices or features to coincide with vertices/edges/endpoints of reference features within specified distance.
L3_03_01_01 Clip Raster by Geometry Clips a raster dataset using vector polygon boundaries; pixels outside the geometry are set to NoData.
L3_03_01_02 Clip Raster by Extent Clips a raster dataset using a rectangular bounding box (extent); retains all pixels within the extent.
L3_03_01_03 Extract by Condition Extracts raster cells that satisfy a specified condition (attribute-based query or value range).
L3_03_01_04 Select Bands Selects specific bands from a multi-band raster dataset.
L3_03_01_05 Update Mask Updates the raster mask based on a condition; sets invalid pixels to NoData.
L3_03_01_09 Add/Concatenate Bands Adds or concatenates bands from multiple images into a single multi-band image.
L3_03_02_01 Zonal Statistics Calculates statistics for raster values within zones defined by vector polygons.
L3_03_02_03 Focal Statistics Calculates statistics for each pixel based on values in a defined neighborhood (moving window).
L3_03_02_05 Global Statistics Computes summary statistics for the entire raster dataset (or within analysis extent).

L3_03_03_A Arithmetic & Math [L3_03_03_01] Performs basic arithmetic operations (addition | [L3_03_03_04] Applies advanced mathematical functions (exponential | [L3_03_03_06] Performs binary bitwise operations (AND
L3_03_03_L Logical & Comparison [L3_03_03_02] Performs Boolean logical operations (AND | [L3_03_03_03] Performs relational comparison operations between rasters or raster and scalar values.
L3_03_04_01 Reclassify / Remap Remaps raster values based on a lookup table; transforms old values to new values or class codes.
L3_03_04_02 Slice (Discretization) Divides continuous raster values into discrete classes using equal interval
L3_03_04_03 Conditional Reclassification (Con) Reclassifies raster based on conditional expression; assigns specified values where condition is true or false.
L3_03_05_02 Reproject Transforms raster to a different coordinate reference system; may also change resolution during transformation.
L3_03_07_01 Mosaic to New Raster Merges multiple rasters into a single continuous raster using rule-based pixel selection (first/last/min/max/mean).
L3_03_08_01 Vegetation Indices Calculates vegetation indices such as NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) and EVI (Enhanced Vegetation Index) using multi-spectral bands.
L3_03_08_02 Water/Urban/Other Indices Calculates domain-specific spectral indices: NDWI for water
L3_03_08_03 DN to Radiance/TOA Converts sensor Digital Numbers (DN) to at-sensor radiance or Top-of-Atmosphere (TOA) reflectance using calibration coefficients.
L3_03_08_04 Atmospheric Correction Corrects for atmospheric scattering and absorption to derive surface reflectance from TOA reflectance.
L3_03_08_05 Brightness Temperature Converts thermal infrared band DN or radiance to brightness temperature in Kelvin or Celsius.
L3_03_08_06 Cloud & Shadow Detection Identifies cloud and cloud shadow pixels using spectral characteristics and geometric projection.
L3_03_08_07 Spectral Transformations Transforms multi-spectral data using PCA (Principal Component Analysis) or Tasseled Cap to create uncorrelated or physically meaningful components.
L3_03_08_08 Pan-sharpening Fuses high-resolution panchromatic band with lower-resolution multispectral bands to create enhanced spatial resolution color imagery.
L3_03_08_10 Quality Band Parsing Parses quality/QA bands using bitwise operations to extract quality flags and filter low-quality pixels.
L3_03_09_01 Filter by Date Range Filters an image collection by start and end dates to select images within a specific temporal window.
L3_03_09_02 Filter by Month/Season Filters an image collection by specific months or seasons (e.g., summer months 6-8) across multiple years.
L3_03_09_04 Filter by Day of Year Filters images by day of year (DOY, 1-365/366) to select specific periods regardless of year.
L3_03_09_05 Filter by Metadata Property Filters an image collection based on metadata properties such as cloud cover, satellite orbit, or quality flags.
L3_03_09_06 Filter by Spatial Bounds Filters an image collection to include only images that intersect with a specified geographic region.
L3_03_09_07 Filter by Image Count/Limit Limits the number of images in a collection by taking the first N images or applying count constraints.

L3_03_10_R Temporal Reducer [L3_03_10_01] Computes the pixel-wise median across all images in a time series, reducing outliers and noise. | [L3_03_10_02] Computes the pixel-wise arithmetic mean across all images in a time series. | [L3_03_10_03] Computes the pixel-wise maximum value across all images in a time series. | [L3_03_10_04] Computes the pixel-wise minimum value across all images in a time series. | [L3_03_10_05] Computes the pixel-wise sum of all images in a time series. | [L3_03_10_08] Computes pixel-wise percentiles (e.g., 25th, 75th) across all images in a time series for robust statistical aggregation. | [L3_03_10_09] Counts the number of valid (non-masked) observations per pixel across a time series. | [L3_03_10_10] Selects the first or last image in a temporally sorted image collection. | [L3_03_10_12] Aggregates images within regular time intervals (daily, monthly, yearly) using a reduction function.
L3_03_11_05 Polynomial Trend Fits a polynomial regression model to time series data to identify non-linear temporal trends.
L3_03_12_01 Bi-temporal Differencing Detects changes by subtracting pixel values between two images from different dates.
L3_03_13_04 Length of Season Calculates the duration of the growing season from time series vegetation indices.
L3_04_01_01 Slope Gradient Calculates slope gradient (rate of change in elevation) in degrees or percent from a DEM.
L3_04_01_02 Aspect Direction Calculates the downslope direction (compass bearing) of maximum rate of elevation change.
L3_04_01_03 Hillshade Generates shaded relief map simulating illumination from a specified sun position for visualization.
L3_04_02_02 Terrain Ruggedness Index (TRI) Calculates terrain ruggedness from elevation differences between each raster cell and its neighbors.
L3_04_05_09 Lake Inundation Fills a connected lake or inundation area from a seed location up to a specified water level on an elevation raster.
L3_05_03_03 Grouping Analysis Automatically determines optimal number of groups and assigns features to groups using spatial and attribute characteristics.
L3_06_01_02 Delaunay Triangulation Performs Delaunay triangulation on point features to create triangle mesh satisfying Delaunay criterion.
L3_07_01_01 Apply Simple Symbol Applies a single symbol style (color size shape) to all features in a layer.
L3_07_01_05 Render Raster (RGB Composite) Combines multiple raster bands into RGB color image for true-color or false-color visualization.
L3_07_01_06 Label Features Adds text labels to map features based on attribute values with placement and styling options.
L3_07_04_01 Export To Shapefile Exports vector features to Shapefile format for data sharing and archiving.
L3_07_04_05 Export Raster To GeoTIFF Exports raster data to GeoTIFF format with georeferencing.
L3_07_04_06 Export Raster To Image Exports raster to non-georeferenced image format (PNG JPEG) for display.

L3_08_01_01 Region-based Sample Extraction Extracts labeled training samples from imagery or time-series stacks by intersecting ROI features with pixel values, writing spectral profiles and class IDs to a sample table.
L3_08_01_02 Stratified Random Sampling Builds balanced samples per class or per stratum by randomly generating points/pixels within training polygons, enforcing quotas or proportional weights.
L3_08_02_01 Spectral Index Generation Computes vegetation, water, burn, or soil indices (NDVI, NDWI, NBR, SAVI, etc.) from multispectral imagery to enrich feature stacks.
L3_08_02_02 Texture & Context Metrics Generates GLCM textures, entropy, variance, or contextual statistics in moving windows to characterize spatial patterns.
L3_08_02_03 Morphological Profiles Applies opening/closing, top-hat/bottom-hat, or multi-scale morphological filters to emphasize shapes and objects in imagery.
L3_08_02_04 Temporal Statistics Aggregation Aggregates time-series imagery into metrics such as temporal mean, median, max NDVI, amplitude, or phenological phases.
L3_08_02_05 Dimensionality Reduction & PCA Transforms correlated bands/features into orthogonal components (PCA, MNF) or embeds them using autoencoders to reduce redundancy.
L3_08_03_01 Train Random Forest Classifier Fits an ensemble of decision trees for categorical prediction using user-defined tree counts, depth, and sampling strategy.
L3_08_03_02 Train Support Vector Machine Optimizes an SVM classifier/regressor with kernel selection, penalty, and gamma parameters for high-dimensional feature spaces.
L3_08_04_01 Apply Classifier to Imagery Applies a trained classifier to imagery/feature stacks to produce labeled rasters or vectors representing thematic classes.
L3_08_04_02 Probability & Confidence Surfaces Generates per-class probability rasters, confidence layers, or uncertainty scores to quantify prediction strength.

L3_08_05_C Pixel Clustering & Segmentation [L3_08_05_01] Clusters pixels/features into K groups using Euclidean distance in feature space to derive unsupervised land-cover classes. | [L3_08_05_02] Runs ISODATA/EM-style clustering allowing automatic split/merge of classes based on variance and distance thresholds. | [L3_08_05_03] Generates object segments (superpixels) using algorithms like SNIC or SLIC to support OBIA workflows and contextual features.

L3_08_07_01 Confusion Matrix & Accuracy Report Computes confusion matrix from classification results and reference data, calculating overall accuracy, producer's/consumer's accuracy, kappa coefficient, F-score, and other classification accuracy metrics.
L3_09_03_01 Mean/Median/Bilateral Filtering Applies simple kernels (mean, median, bilateral) to reduce salt-and-pepper noise while preserving edges.
L3_09_05_02 Cloud Shadow/Mask Refinement Refines cloud and shadow masks using spectral tests, morphological dilation, or multi-spectral indexes.
L3_09_06_01 Histogram Equalization/Matching Performs global or reference-based histogram equalization/matching to enhance contrast.
L3_09_06_02 Gamma/Log/Power-law Adjustment Applies gamma, log, or power-law tone curves for brightness adjustments and dynamic range compression.
L3_09_07_01 Histogram/Curve Matching Between Scenes Matches color/illumination between scenes by transferring histograms or tone curves.
L3_09_09_01 Laplacian/Directional Edge Enhancement Uses Laplacian or directional gradients to emphasize edges and micro-texture.
L3_10_02_01 Quality Mosaic / Best Pixel Composite Selects the best pixel from a time series based on quality criteria (cloud-free highest NDVI etc) to create a composite.
L3_10_02_03 Multi-temporal Averaging Averages or takes the median of time-series observations to reduce noise and create stable composites.
L3_10_03_01 Weighted Average Fusion Combines co-registered images using pixel-wise weighted averaging based on quality variance or user-defined weights.
L3_10_04_01 Feature Stacking Concatenates feature bands from multiple sources (spectral indices textures derivatives) into a single multi-band stack.
L3_10_06_01 Image-to-Image Registration Aligns one image to another using geometric transformation based on control points or optimization.
